title: Regroup Settings tabs by operator workflow
summary: Regrouped the Settings top-level navigation from media-category tabs into operator workflow tabs while preserving existing settings panels, backend Preview/Save authority, staged-change behavior, and command history semantics.
reason: The previous tab order made high-impact paths, safety, routing, publish, runtime, and raw evidence controls harder to scan. The new IA groups the existing panels around how an operator prepares, validates, and publishes media output without changing backend settings policy.
behavior_before: Settings exposed separate top-level tabs for Summary / Effective Decision, Routing, Dimensions, Filters, Video, Audio, Subtitles, Container, Verification / Publish, Presets, Rename, and Advanced.
behavior_after: Settings exposes Status, Guided Setup, Paths & Safety, Routing & Size, Media Output, Publish & Recovery, Naming, Queue & Runtime, and Advanced Evidence. Retired stored tab IDs fall back through the existing lifecycle default, and OCR guidance now points to Settings > Media Output.
tests_added: Updated Settings static tab-order assertions for the new operator workflow tab IDs and retired tab IDs.
Updated browser Settings smoke helper to open Media Output for subtitle controls.
Updated final-library promotion, diagnostics, and libraries static assertions for the regrouped Settings destinations.
